name: AeroGalactica
description: AeroGalactica is building a new kind of computational engineering platform for advanced hardware design. Today, engineers must move between disconnected tools for CAD, meshing, simulation, optimization, and manufacturability, which creates major translation friction and slows iteration. We are building toward an AI-native system that unifies these steps, beginning with high-value thermal-fluid and propulsion hardware; industries where iteration speed is the most valuable currency.

name: Aion Medtech
description: Surgeons and dentists suffer from intense neck pain due to non ergonomic optical loupes. We are creating a digital replacement for current surgical loupes. Our solution aims to relieve professionals of pain while maintaining work quality.

name: airfairness
description: Airfairness simplifies the process of securing compensation for air travelers affected by flight delays, cancellations, or disruptions. Leveraging expertise in international passenger rights, we ensure travelers receive what they’re entitled to without hassle. Operating on a success-based model, Airfairness is committed to transparency, efficiency, and making air travel fair for everyone.

name: appfi
description: Appfi is a mobile app that builds mobile apps. Type what you want, see a working preview on your phone in seconds, share it, then send it to Apple’s TestFlight for beta testing and publish to the App Store—no developers, no Xcode, and no Mac required.

name: Applied Intelligence
description: Applied Intelligence is a platform that blends predictive analysis with A.I agents letting you get the best insights plus the ability to act on them automatically.

name: Arc Light AI
description: We are building an AI copilot for city planners, engineers, and architects to streamline the housing development approval process. Currently, approvals for development typically take up to two years. This long wait time delays construction, drives up costs, and limits the availability of new housing, making it harder for cities to meet growing demand. name: Argos Research
description: Argos Research is an AI lab developing Programmatic AI: machine intelligence expressed as programs rather than weights, so that what a system learns can be read, checked, and carried into situations it was never trained on.

name: ARTISH
description: ARTISH is a workflow management solution for creative teams and agencies to centralise project-related ops and tracking.

name: BaseLeaf
